object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Call the MCP server's export tool for a document with a relative output path, then with an absolute output path, and once with the real PDF program. Expected: each call succeeds; the PDF is written at the output path, a relative path being read from the repository root; the result names that path and the number of bytes written; the real run writes a file that starts with %PDF.
